fact: Seychelles Nation reports the Department of Immigration and Civil Status has rolled out a system in which maternity wards must electronically notify Civil Status of births within 3 days, while parents still declare the birth at Civil Status within 30 days.
Seychelles told the UN Statistics Division that completeness of registration of live births and deaths was 100 per cent for 2023, estimated from administrative data, with no digital system named.

The World Bank's SPI scores Seychelles 1 on birth and death registration at least 90% and 75% complete (SDG 17.19.2) in its 2024 round, a national rate not tied to a digital system; dated to the round's year.
